===Additional quests===
Other quests give [[Quest experience rewards#Attack|Attack]], [[Quest experience rewards#Strength|Strength]], and [[Quest experience rewards#Defence|Defence]] experience, but they have higher requirements. Some of them are listed in the table below.

Once completed, the [[Recipe for Disaster]] quest gives access to the [[Culinaromancer's gloves]]. They provide significant offensive bonuses.
